currency_assumptions: All venue prices are published in US dollars; local and comparison currency are the same, so no FX conversion is applied and no rate is stored.
A published hourly rate is multiplied by 8 or 12 hours only where the listing leaves the room bookable for that whole interval; the result is labelled estimated_from_rate, not a quote.
A published day or session rate is recorded as published_rate and is not converted into a different window it does not cover.
The soft budget for scoring is USD 5,000; exactly USD 5,000 is not over budget, and cost is never a gate.

declared_gaps.text: The Monroe Room's map pin marks the building at 15 West 38th Street rather than a proven door, because two OpenStreetMap points exist for the address and only the west-side one is used.

Ridgewood Hall's map pin marks the building at 60-47 Metropolitan Avenue rather than an entrance, and the postcode is recorded as both 11378 (Middle Village) and 11385 (Ridgewood), so treat the location as the block.
Civic Hall is recorded at 124 East 14th Street (Zero Irving, Union Square), which is what the operator's contact page prints, after an earlier record of 28 East 28th Street was corrected.
